column1: # Game profile of Axiom Verge (Switch, update 1.0.3 = v131072; the base game v0 is another program, SDK 0.12.17, not brought up). Plays on the Mac (title, a new game, the intro, Eribu, a save load, at 60 fps with sound); runs on an iPhone 16 Pro Max and an iPad Pro M4 (iOS 26.0) at 60 fps with two host fixes (see README.md)
# MonoGame for the Switch, its C# and the game's compiled to C++ by Sickhead's BRUTE into main; sound through the SDK's audio renderer (nn::audio), SDK 4.4.0.

# The shaders are MonoGame effects (MGFX version 8): 17 in Content/ShadersNX/*.xnb, and SpriteBatch's built-in effects in main (shader_split.py mgfx_effect). The provisional profile's guesses held: no key needed changing

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# only the merged 1.0.3 copy is brought up: the update replaces the whole program (base v0: five modules on SDK 0.12.17)
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: it sets a heap of the application pool − used memory and allocates from it.
# The block is 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region
# the NPDM declares no system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# used memory for the rewritten modules (the NSP script's measurement of them)
